precondition.description: A sovereign consumer supplies a named intended treasury use and asks Aagaard to bind one offer to its latest settled fleet tick.

postcondition.description: Aagaard returns an aggregate and account-level observation derived from the exact source-tick digest and writes only its own exchange, receipt, book, CloudEvent, and EAVT evidence. No key is read and no chain act is attempted.

consideration.description: The consumer contributes one attributable sovereign demand and intended-use signal that Aagaard may use as evidence of a real customer relation; it is not money, a token, or an allocation currency.

disputeResolution.firstStep: the parties compare their exact receipt, source-tick digest, fulfillment digest, and separate books
disputeResolution.unresolvedAuthorityDispute: general-counsel service required; none is claimed by this contract
